basic_info.description: Light-filled, house-like, remodeled, top floor, two-level condominium in the heart of sought-after NOPA, epitomizing the perfect blend classic charm and modern convenience. Located in a well-maintained building with only two units, this ideal urban sanctuary offers three bedrooms, two baths, sunroom, parking, storage, and private walkout deck with amazing views towards the city skyline and Buena Vista Park.  On the main level is a spacious living room with fireplace, built-in bookshelves, and soaring vaulted ceilings, perfect for entertaining guests or relaxing with family. Also on this level is the dining room, gourmet chef's kitchen w/granite counters and high-end appliances, two bedrooms,sunroom, and full bath. A beautiful staircase leads to the second level which has an exquisite primary suite w/fireplace, high ceilings, luxurious bath w/jetted tub, and French doors leading to the large, exclusive-use view deck.Other features include: in-unit washer/dryer, plentiful closets,gleaming wood floors, one car parking, storage, skylights, recessed lighting. Centrally located near the Panhandle, USF, shopping, grocery, restaurants, and transportation options
